y-m-77-01.title: Ukuhlola izinombolo embikweni wejubane lokulethwa kokuya nokubuya
y-m-77-01.goal: Hlola ngokubala ukuthi ijubane eliphakathi lohambo lokuya nokubuya lingase lingalingani nesilinganiso esilula samajubane amabili, bese usho ukuthi lilingana nini.
y-m-77-01.material: Umshayeli wokulethwa wenza uhambo lokuya nokubuya ebangeni eliyindlela eyodwa elingu-12 km. Endleleni yokuya, umshayeli waya ku-30 km ngehora, futhi endleleni yokubuya, ku-20 km ngehora (cabanga ukuthi akukho ukuma nejubane elingaguquki ekhaleni ngalinye). Umbiko wozakwethu uyisebenza ngale ndlela elandelayo.
y-m-77-01.thinking.0: Thola umugqa embikweni weqiwe ngaphandle kwesizathu
y-m-77-01.thinking.1: Hlola inani usebenzisa izincazelo zebanga eliphelele nesikhathi esiphelele
y-m-77-01.thinking.2: Yenza amapheya amaningana amajubane ahambisana nezimo
y-m-77-01.prereq.0: Kulo msebenzi, u-'H3' ulebula nje yezinga lobunzima nosizo kulokhu kwabiwa kokukhiqiza. Akusho ukuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo wabela lesi sifundo ebangeni elithile. Cabanga ukuthi izibalo zemisebenzi yesikole esiphakeme sithathwa ezingeni eliphezulu lobunzima, nokuthi usuvele wazi izilinganiso zesikole esiphakathi, amaphesenti, izilinganiso nezisho ezinoguquguquko ngezinhlamvu.
y-m-77-01.prereq.1: Ijubane = ibanga ÷ isikhathi, incazelo yesilinganiso (izinga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-77-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa emsebenzini kozakwenu ongenasisekelo noma ophosile.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumugqa ngamunye, hlukanisa ukuthi ulanda nje izimo zenkinga (ibanga, ijubane) noma wenza isimangalo esisha.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thola isikhathi sokuya nesikhathi sokubuya, bhala isamba, bese ubeka leli nani eceleni kokubala kwesikhathi embikweni ukuze uqhathanise.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuya: hamba u-12 km ngo-30 km ngehora.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukubuya: buya u-12 km ngo-20 km ngehora.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.2: Ijubane eliphakathi lisilinganiso samajubane amabili, ngakho (30+20)÷2 = 25 km/h.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.3: Uhambo lokuya nokubuya olungu-24 km lungenziwa ngo-25 km ngehora, ngakho isikhathi esithathiwe singu-24÷25 = 0.96 amahora.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 1 no-2 ikopisha nje izimo, ngakho ilungile. Umugqa 3 lapho inkinga iqala khona. Ijubane eliphakathi 'libanga eliphelele ÷ isikhathi esiphelele', kodwa nakuba izikhathi zokuya nokubuya zihlukile, amajubane amabili enziwe isilinganiso ngesisindo esilinganayo. Empeleni, ukuya kuthatha u-12÷30=0.4 amahora futhi ukubuya kuthatha u-12÷20=0.6 amahora, ngakho uhambo lonke lithatha ihora elingu-1, futhi ijubane eliphakathi ngu-24÷1=24 km/h. Umugqa 4 usebenzisa u-25 womugqa 3 njengoba unjalo, okunika isikhathi esiphosile esingu-0.96 amahora. Noma ukhethe umugqa 3 noma umugqa 4, ubone umugqa oweluleke iphutha, kodwa imbangela ngumugqa 3.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi umgwaqo ofanayo uhanjwa ngejubane le-a km ngehora ekuyeni ne-b km ngehora ekubuyeni. Yenza amapheya amabili ahlukile (a, b) lapho ijubane eliphakathi lohambo lonke lokuya nokubuya (ibanga eliphelele ÷ isikhathi esiphelele) liyinombolo yemvelo. U-a no-b bayizinombolo zemvelo ezihlukile kusuka ku-10 kuya ku-100, futhi ibanga lendlela eyodwa alinandaba. U-(30, 20) usunikeziwe njengesibonelo, ngakho ushiye. U-(a, b) no-(b, a) babalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.0: Setha ibanga lendlela eyodwa libe ngu-12 km, bese ngepheya ngalinye elihlongozwayo (a, b), thola isikhathi sokuya nesikhathi sokubuya bese uyabangeza.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ngamapheya amaningana ahlongozwayo, hlela ethebuleni ukuthi ibanga eliphelele lihlukaniswe ngesikhathi esiphelele liyinombolo yemvelo yini, bese ubheka ukuthi amapheya anika inombolo yemvelo anayiphi into efanayo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c1: U-a no-b bayizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-10 kuya ku-100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze u-a no-b babe yizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-10 kuya ku-100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c3: U-(30, 20) usunikeziwe njengesibonelo. Zama ukuthola ipheya elihlukile.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Ijubane eliphakathi lokuya nokubuya liyinombolo yemvelo.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Ijubane eliphakathi lokuya nokubuya akuyona inombolo yemvelo. Bala futhi ibanga eliphelele nesikhathi esiphelele.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma ibanga lendlela eyodwa lingu-d, isikhathi singu-d/a+d/b futhi ijubane eliphakathi lingu-2ab/(a+b). Ku-(60, 40) lingu-48, ku-(40, 10) lingu-16, futhi ku-(60, 30) lingu-40. Noma yipheya liphi olikhethayo, ijubane eliphakathi lingaphansi noma lilingana nesilinganiso esilula samajubane amabili. Lilingana nesilinganiso esilula kuphela uma amajubane amabili elingana.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.prompt: Chazela ozakwenu 'ukuthi kungani isilinganiso singesona u-25'. Sebenzisa izikhathi zokuya nokubuya njengobufakazi bakho, bese wengeza umusho owodwa ngokuthi kukhona yini amacala lapho isilinganiso esilula samajubane amabili silungile.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala isikhathi sokuya nesikhathi sokubuya njengezinombolo.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.1: Zama ukuqala ngomusho oqhathanisa isikhathi esibalwe ngo-25 (0.96 amahora) nesikhathi esithathiwe ngempela.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Usho ngamazwi akho ukuthi izikhathi zokuya nokubuya ziyahluka?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unikeze inani elibalwe kubanga eliphelele nesikhathi esiphelele njengenombolo?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Usho isimo esisodwa se-'amacala lapho isilinganiso esilula silungile'?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.0: Ijubane eliphakathi libanga eliphelele lihlukaniswe ngesikhathi esiphelele. Ukuya kuthatha u-12÷30=0.4 amahora futhi ukubuya kuthatha u-12÷20=0.6 amahora, ngakho kuthatha ihora elingu-1 ngokuphelele, futhi njengoba umshayeli ahambe u-24 km, kungu-24 km/h. Ukubuya kuhamba kancane, ngakho kuthatha isikhathi eside, yingakho kungesiso u-25. Isilinganiso esilula silungile uma amajubane amabili elingana, noma uma izikhathi zamakhaleni amabili zilingana.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.1: Uma umshayeli ebehambe ngo-25, bekufanele kuthathe u-24÷25=0.96 amahora, kodwa empeleni kuthatha u-0.4+0.6=1 ihora. Isikhathi esichithwe ngejubane elihamba kancane side, ngakho isilinganiso singu-24, okungaphansi kuka-25. Uma amajubane ekuyeni nasekubuyeni ayefana, isilinganiso esilula bekuzoba silungile.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo enikeza isimo sokuthi isilinganiso esilula silungile kuphela 'uma amajubane elingana' nayo iyamukeleka.

y-m-77-03.title: Izindleko zokupakisha ibhokisi: ingabe umthetho owodwa unikeza intengo ephansi kakhulu?
y-m-77-03.goal: Khombisa ngokubala ukuthi umthetho othi 'sebenzisa amabhokisi amaningi kakhulu angabizi kakhulu ngento ngayinye' awuqinisekisi izindleko eziphansi kakhulu kuleli oda, bese wenza izindlela ezimbalwa zokupakisha ezinelisa izimo.
y-m-77-03.material: Indlu yokugcina ifuna ukuthumela izingxenye ezingu-100 ezihlukaniswe ezinhlotsheni ezimbili zamabhokisi. Ibhokisi elikhulu (L) liphatha izingxenye ezingu-12 ubuningi futhi libiza u-1,500원 ibhokisi ngalinye, futhi ibhokisi elincane (S) liphatha izingxenye ezingu-8 ubuningi futhi libiza u-1,100원 ibhokisi ngalinye. Amabhokisi angashiya izikhala ezingenalutho, kodwa zonke izingxenye ezingu-100 kumele zipakishwe. Noma yimangaki amabhokisi angasetshenziswa. Isisebenzi esisodwa samangalela izindleko eziphansi kakhulu kanje.
y-m-77-03.thinking.2: Ukuthola izimo lapho umthetho usebenza ngokuqinisekile
y-m-77-03.prereq.1: Ikhwosheni nesisele ekuhlukaniseni, ama-linear inequality (izinga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-77-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa kumangalelo wesisebenzi ongenasisekelo noma ophosile.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uzihlolele ukuthi ukubala emigqeni 1 no-3 kulungile yini.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza izinhlanganisela ezimbalwa ezisebenzisa amabhokisi amakhulu angaphansi kuka-8, uhlole ukuthi zonke izingxenye ezingu-100 ziyangena yini, bese ubala izindleko.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.0: Ibhokisi elikhulu libiza u-1,500÷12 = 125원 ngento ngayinye, futhi ibhokisi elincane libiza u-1,100÷8 = 137.5원 ngento ngayinye.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.1: Ngakho, ukusebenzisa amabhokisi amakhulu amaningi kakhulu kuyintengo ephansi kakhulu.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.2: U-100÷12 unekhwosheni elingu-8 nesisele esingu-4, ngakho sebenzisa amabhokisi amakhulu angu-8 (ezinto ezingu-96) nebhokisi elincane elingu-1 (lezinto ezisele ezingu-4).
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.3: Izindleko ziyi-1,500×8 + 1,100×1 = 13,100원, futhi lezi yizona zindleko eziphansi kunazo zonke.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.explain: Ukubala intengo ngento ngayinye emugqeni 1 nokubala i-quotient ne-remainder emugqeni 3 kulungile. Umugqa 2 ujwayelekisa ngokuthi 'ishibhile ngento ngayinye, ngakho sebenzisa eziningi ngangokunokwenzeka' ngaphandle kwesizathu. Endleleni yomugqa 3, ibhokisi elincane elilodwa linezikhala ezingu-4 ezingenalutho, kodwa uma usebenzisa amabhokisi amakhulu angu-7 namabhokisi amancane angu-2, ugcwalisa ncamashi izinto ezingu-84+16=100, futhi izindleko zingu-10,500+2,200=12,700원. U-13,100원 emugqeni 4 akuyona eyiphansi kunazo zonke. Noma ukhethe umugqa 2 noma umugqa 4, ubone umugqa ongalungile.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa amabhokisi amakhulu angu-a namabhokisi amancane angu-b, yenza izinhlanganisela zokupakisha ezibamba izingxenye ezingu-100 noma ngaphezulu futhi zishibhile kuno-13,100원 owashiwo yisisebenzi. a no-b ziyizinombolo eziqondile ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu. Thola izinhlanganisela ezimbili ezihlukene.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.0: Shintsha inani lamabhokisi amakhulu a libe ngu-5, 6, 7, no-8, bese uthola inani elincane kakhulu lamabhokisi amancane adingekayo ukubamba izinto ezingu-100.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kokukhethiwe ngakunye, bhala ethebuleni ukuthi inani lezikhala okungenani ngu-100 yini nokuthi izindleko zingaphansi kuka-13,100 yini, bese uhlola.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani lamabhokisi liyinombolo eqondile engu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Inani lamabhokisi kumele libe yinombolo eqondile engu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Le nhlanganisela ayikwazi ukubamba izinto ezingu-100. Bala kabusha izikhala ezisemabhokisini.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Izindleko ziyi-13,100원 noma ngaphezulu. Funa inhlanganisela eshibhile.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.explain: Izinhlanganisela kuphela ezanelisa izimo ngu-(7, 2) no-(5, 5). U-(7, 2) ubiza u-12,700원 futhi unezikhala ezingu-100 ncamashi. U-(5, 5) ubiza u-7,500+5,500=13,000원 futhi unezikhala ezingu-100 ncamashi. Akukho okunesikhala esingenalutho. Indlela yokusebenzisa amabhokisi amakhulu angu-8 bese ufaka okusele ebhokisini elincane iyashiya izikhala ezingu-4 ezingenalutho ebhokisini lokugcina elincane.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.prompt: Kuhlobo luni lwe-oda ongasho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi umthetho othi 'sebenzisa amabhokisi amaningi ngangokunokwenzeka ashibhile ngento ngayinye, bese ufaka izingxenye ezisele ebhokisini elincane' unikeza izindleko eziphansi kunazo zonke? (Izintengo nosayizi bamabhokisi kuhlala kunjalo.)
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kuhlobo ngalunye lwe-oda, qhathanisa izindleko zokupakisha ngomthetho nezindleko uma usebenzisa ibhokisi elikhulu elilodwa kancane namabhokisi amancane amaningi.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ama-oda lapho umthetho ushiya izikhala ezingenalutho nama-oda lapho ungazishiyi.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.a: Noma ngo-98, amabhokisi amakhulu angu-7 namabhokisi amancane angu-2 (12,700원) ashibhile kuneamabhokisi amakhulu angu-8 nebhokisi elincane elingu-1 (13,100원). Leli yi-oda lapho umthetho uphuka.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.b: Izikhala ziyahambisana ncamashi namabhokisi amakhulu kuphela, futhi akukho nhlanganisela enenani eliphansi ngesikhala kunaleyo, okuyisisekelo.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.c: Njengoba usanda kuhlola, ngo-100 kunenhlanganisela eshibhile kunalokho okunikezwa umthetho.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.o.d: Kunjalo kuwo wonke ama-oda, noma ngabe zingaki izingxenye
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.d: Ukusho ukuthi kusebenza kuwo wonke ama-oda, kumele ubonise ukuthi akukho isibonelo esiphikisayo, kodwa sekukhona isibonelo esiphikisayo esingu-100.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.explain: Ezingu-96 ziyahambisana ncamashi emabhokisini amakhulu angu-8, futhi izindleko ziyi-12,000원. Kunoma iyiphi inhlanganisela, inani ngesikhala okungenani lingu-125원 futhi kumele kube nezikhala okungenani ezingu-96, ngakho izindleko okungenani ziyi-125×96=12,000원. Ngakho u-12,000원 uyona encane kakhulu. Umthetho ulungile ama-oda lapho amabhokisi ashibhile ngento ngayinye kuphela ahambisana ncamashi (izingxenye eziphindwe ngo-12), futhi kuma-oda anesisele udinga ukuhlola.

y-m-77-05.title: Uma wenza uhlu lwamanani olunomphetho obungu-25%, yini okumele siyibuze kuqala?
y-m-77-05.topic: Isisekelo sezinga lomphetho nokusetha intengo yokuthengisa
y-m-77-05.goal: Azi ukuthi noma iphesenti elifanayo linikeza inani elihlukile kuye ngokuthi lisilinganiso sobuningi buphi, bese ubhala njengemibuzo isisekelo okumele usihlole ngaphambi kokusetha intengo.
y-m-77-05.material: Isitolo sezinto zokubhala sifuna ukusetha intengo yohlu yento enezindleko ezingu-8,000원. Inkokhelo yeqembu ithe, 'Sicela usethe intengo yohlu enomphetho ongu-25%.' Umphetho yinzuzo yentengo yohlu kususwe izindleko (intengo yohlu − izindleko), futhi ungazinaki izintela nezinye izindleko. Isisebenzi 가 sithe, 'Engeza u-25% wezindleko, ngakho 8,000×1.25=10,000원.' Isisebenzi 나 sithe, 'Isabelo somphetho entengweni yohlu kumele sibe ngu-25%, ngakho uma intengo yohlu ingu-P, khona (P−8,000)÷P=0.25, okungukuthi, P≈10,667원.'
y-m-77-05.thinking.0: Ukwahlulela ukuthi ulwazi lwanele yini nokukhomba lokho okushodayo
y-m-77-05.thinking.1: Ukwenza amacala lapho inani lesilinganiso lishintsha kuye ngobuningi besisekelo
y-m-77-05.thinking.2: Ukubhala umyalezo ocela omunye ulwazi oludingekayo
y-m-77-05.prereq.1: Incazelo yamaphesenti nezilinganiso, ukuxazulula izibalo ze-linear (izinga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-77-05.s.s1.prompt: Yisiphi isinqumo esifaneleke kakhulu ngokubala kwezisebenzi ezimbili?
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala umugqa owodwa ngakunye ukuthi 가 no-나 basebenzise u-'25%' njengesilinganiso sini, bese beqhathanisa.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.1: Usebenzisa intengo yohlu yesisebenzi ngasinye, bala umphetho ÷ izindleko nomphetho ÷ intengo yohlu, bese uhlola ukuthi yiliphi eliphuma ku-25%.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.a: Ukubala kwesisebenzi 가 kulungile. Iphesenti liphindaphindwa ngezindleko lengezwe, ngakho isibalo sika-나 asidingeki
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ngokwezindleko kuphela. Ubungacabangi ukuthi umphetho ungavezwa nanjengesilinganiso sentengo yohlu.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.b: Ukubala kwesisebenzi 나 kulungile. Izinga lenzuzo lihlale lisho njengesilinganiso sentengo yohlu, ngakho isibalo sika-가 asilungile
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ngentengo yohlu kuphela. Kuvamile nokuthi izinga lomphetho livezwe njengesilinganiso sezindleko.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.c: Uma sisetha cishe u-10,333원, maphakathi namanani amabili, kubonisa kokubili ukubala kuka-가 nokuka-나
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukuxuba amanani amabili kunikeza inani elingafanelani nencazelo ngayinye. Iqiniso lokuthi izisekelo ziyahluka alixazululwa.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.d: Zombili izibalo zilungile. Sidinga ukubuza inkokhelo yeqembu ukuthi u-25% usilinganiso sini
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.d: Uqaphele ukuthi izibalo ezimbili zisebenzise izisekelo ezihlukile, futhi wazama kuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yisiphi isisekelo.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.explain: 가 uchaze izinga lomphetho njengesilinganiso sezindleko, no-나 njengesilinganiso sentengo yohlu, futhi ukubala ngakunye kulungile. 'Umphetho ongu-25%' wodwa awunqumi ukuthi yisiphi isisekelo, ngakho intengo yohlu ayinqunywa njengenani elilodwa. Uma ukhetha eyodwa kwezimbili ngokungahleliwe, ingahluka kulokho inkokhelo yeqembu ekufunayo.
y-m-77-05.s.s2.prompt: Uma umehluko phakathi kwezintengo zohlu ezivela ezincazelweni ezimbili mkhulu, ilahleko ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle iba nkulu. Uma kunezindleko ezingu-c원 nezinga lomphetho elingu-m%, yenza izibonelo ezimbili ezihlukene lapho umehluko phakathi kwentengo yohlu esekelwe ezindlekweni (c×(1+m÷100)) nentengo yohlu esekelwe entengweni yohlu (c÷(1−m÷100)) ungu-1,000원 noma ngaphezulu. c inombolo yemvelo ngamayunithi angu-1,000원 (kusuka ku-1,000 kuya ku-100,000), futhi m inombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-5 kuya ku-50. y-m-77-07.s.s3.model.0: Imiholo yenyanga (ngaphambi kwentela) yezisebenzi ezi-5 ngu-250, 280, 300, 370, no-800만 원. Isilinganiso singu-400만 원, kodwa umholo ophakathi wenyanga ungu-300만 원. Ophansi kakhulu ungu-250만 원 futhi ophezulu kakhulu ungu-800만 원.
y-m-77-07.s.s3.model.1: Isilinganiso somholo wenyanga singu-400만 원 (abantu abangu-5). Umholo ophezulu wenyanga womuntu oyedwa (800만 원) uphakamisa isilinganiso, ngakho umholo ophakathi wenyanga ungu-300만 원 futhi abantu abangu-4 bakhokhelwa ngaphansi kuka-400만 원.
y-m-77-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Lena impendulo esebenzisa idatha yesibonelo (250, 280, 300, 370, 800). Uma umfundi esebenzise enye idatha ayenzile, umuntu kumele ahlole ukuthi izinombolo ziyafana nalokho kudatha.
